name: Karseell Collagen Deep Repair Hair Mask 500ml | Argan Oil & Collagen for Smooth, Shiny Hair
description:
Karseell Collagen Deep Repair Hair Mask restores damaged hair with the nourishing power of argan oil and collagen. This 500ml treatment deeply conditions, strengthens strands from root to tip, and improves elasticity to reduce breakage and split ends. Safe for all hair types, including color-treated hair, it controls frizz and flyaways while leaving hair smooth, shiny, and manageable. Perfect for weekly use, it delivers a salon-like hair treatment at home.
Key Features
 Deep conditioning formula repairs and revitalizes dry, brittle hair
 Enriched with argan oil for soft, smooth, and shiny strands
 Collagen strengthens hair and improves elasticity
 Controls frizz and flyaways for easier styling
 Suitable for all hair types, including color-treated and chemically damaged hair
 Provides salon-like results with long-lasting manageability
How to Use
 Apply generously to clean, damp hair
 Massage from roots to tips for full coverage
 Leave on for 5–10 minutes (or longer for deep conditioning)
 Rinse thoroughly and style as desired
 Use weekly for best results
Material
Argan oil, collagen, nourishing hair care ingredients
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 500ml Karseell Collagen Deep Repair Hair Mask
